villager.name: Villager
villager.schedule: home → park → shops → inn; sleeps at night; lantern at night
dialogue: key item hints ('saw a special item… didn't need it')

weapon-vendor.name: Weapon Vendor
weapon-vendor.service: sells weapons (A +1..+100 any class; S worn→legendary by gnomes), buys anything

item-vendor.name: Item Vendor / General Store
item-vendor.service: A: materials, pet food, formulas, iron lamps, gliders, boats, sugar cubes, flasks; S: flasks (1 coin), bombs, sugar cubes, 1 pet food/day, legendary rings/amulets after 4 gnomes

identifier.name: Identifier (A) / Analyst (S)
identifier.service: identifies leftovers for a fee by level & quality; may roll +1 tier; does not buy

innkeeper.name: Innkeeper
innkeeper.service: 18:00-06:00 → 07:00; A free; S 10 coins + re-roll daily missions; beds heal

adapter.name: Adapter
adapter.service: re-level item to player power for platinum coins; lowering free

flight-master.name: Flight Master
flight-master.service: buy flight points (min 100 coins, scales with distance, permanent); fly to undiscovered points; free to friends; drops you with temporary glider; 5-30 s flight

gem-trader.name: Gem Trader
gem-trader.service: roaming gnome: sells emerald 100 / sapphire 200 / ruby 400 / diamond 800; buys anything; fights nearby enemies

gnome-supplier.name: Gnome Supplier
gnome-supplier.service: captive (4/land); rescue raises shop stock rarity; drops rewards at your feet

adventurer.name: Adventurer group
adventurer.behaviour: roam and fight monsters like players; some hostile (rarity-coloured names)
